instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono) into public/index.html or src/index.css.
Implement smooth scrolling via CSS scroll-behavior or framer-motion scroll handlers.
Use standard Lucide icons for all UI iconography. NEVER use AI emojis for icons.
Implement sticky header with active section tracking using IntersectionObserver or scroll position.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (nav items, CTAs, filter chips, project modal triggers, form inputs, submit buttons).
Connect the contact form in React to post to `${BACKEND_URL}/api/contact` using axios and display a Sonner toast on success or error.
Provide interactive modals or expandable accordion panels for the 3 featured projects to reveal full system architecture, prompt flows, and benchmarks.
Provide a click-to-view Lightbox modal for the TechSolstice Certificate in the Achievements section.
